note: Both sets cover the same baseline mission concept facts (HabEx 4 m/4 instruments/52 m starshade, LUVOIR-A 15 m on-axis/4, LUVOIR-B 8 m off-axis/3, Lynx 3 m grazing-incidence mirror assembly with 10 m focal length/3, Origins 5.9 m/3) with essentially identical wording and quotes. The only differences are cosmetic entity naming (e.g. 'Lynx mirror assembly | focal length' vs 'Lynx | focal length', 'instrument count' vs 'science instrument count'), which do not change correctness. Both sets share the same defects: fragment entities ('n-axis telescope', 'axis telescope', 'spacecraft', 'on-axis/off-axis telescope') that lose the mission binding, the 10 m focal length misreported as a mirror-assembly 'dimension' and 'diameter', the instrument count misbound to the mirror assembly, and the starshade and Lynx mirror diameter facts duplicated.
remarks: Both extractions fragment sentences into generic entities ('n-axis telescope', 'axis telescope', 'spacecraft') that should be bound to LUVOIR-A, LUVOIR-B and HabEx respectively; the 'grazing incidence mirror assembly | dimension/diameter | 10 m' claims misread the 10 m focal length as a diameter (the diameter is 3 m), and the mirror assembly is wrongly credited with the three science instruments. The starshade 52 m and Lynx 3 m diameter facts appear twice in each set under two names.
